fields.title: Direct messages
fields.description: Can you add a feature to direct message another profile? I really want to ask private questions to other profiles sometimes but there is no way to do that. I know I can leave a comment, but that isn’t the best solution sometimes. Direct messages would be awesome!

fields.title: Such a great app!
fields.description: This app is awesome and I just want to say that I love it. I really enjoy scrolling and looking at all the cute pets. I created a profile for each of my dogs and I love sharing them with the world. I am really excited to see where this app goes in the future! You guys are doing a great job! Keep up the good work, and thank you so much for making such a great app!
